From 36397b907355e2fdb5a25a02a7921a937fd8ef4c Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Chengchang Tang <tangchengchang@huawei.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jul 2024 21:37:03 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] RDMA/hns: Fix undifined behavior caused by invalid max_sge

If max_sge has been set to 0, roundup_pow_of_two() in
set_srq_basic_param() may have undefined behavior.

Fixes: 9dd052474a26 ("RDMA/hns: Allocate one more recv SGE for HIP08")
Signed-off-by: Chengchang Tang <tangchengchang@huawei.com>
Signed-off-by: Junxian Huang <huangjunxian6@hisilicon.com>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20240710133705.896445-7-huangjunxian6@hisilicon.com
Signed-off-by: Leon Romanovsky <leon@kernel.org>

diff --git a/drivers/infiniband/hw/hns/hns_roce_srq.c b/drivers/infiniband/hw/hns/hns_roce_srq.c
index f1997abc97ca..c9b8233f4b05 100644
--- a/drivers/infiniband/hw/hns/hns_roce_srq.c
+++ b/drivers/infiniband/hw/hns/hns_roce_srq.c
@@ -297,7 +297,7 @@ static int set_srq_basic_param(struct hns_roce_srq *srq,
 
 	max_sge = proc_srq_sge(hr_dev, srq, !!udata);
 	if (attr->max_wr > hr_dev->caps.max_srq_wrs ||
-	    attr->max_sge > max_sge) {
+	    attr->max_sge > max_sge || !attr->max_sge) {
 		ibdev_err(&hr_dev->ib_dev,
 			  "invalid SRQ attr, depth = %u, sge = %u.\n",
 			  attr->max_wr, attr->max_sge);
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/infiniband/hw/hns/hns_roce_srq.c`**
   - The condition in the `set_srq_basic_param` function has been modified. 
   - The original condition checked if `attr->max_sge` was greater than `max_sge`. The modified condition now also checks if `attr->max_sge` is not zero (`!attr->max_sge`), which prevents undefined behavior when `max_sge` is set to 0.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The modification in the `hns_roce_srq.c` file addresses a potential undefined behavior issue that arises when `max_sge` is set to 0. By adding the check for `!attr->max_sge`, the patch ensures that the function handles this case correctly, thereby preventing the undefined behavior that could occur in the previous implementation. This change is directly related to the bug fix mentioned in the patch description, which aims to enhance the robustness of the code.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
max_sge = proc_srq_sge(hr_dev, srq, !!udata);
srq->max_gs = roundup_pow_of_two(attr->max_sge + srq->rsv_sge);
```
Reason:
The bug occurs because `max_sge` can be set to 0, which is passed to `roundup_pow_of_two()`. This function does not handle zero as a valid input, leading to undefined behavior in the program's execution.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
if (attr->max_sge > max_sge || !attr->max_sge) {
```
Reason:
This additional condition checks if `attr->max_sge` is zero before proceeding to use it in calculations. By ensuring that `attr->max_sge` is not zero, it prevents the call to `roundup_pow_of_two()` with an invalid argument, thus avoiding the undefined behavior.
